hard_case: A `#[macro_export]` generator in `tests/export_support/mod.rs` is named in a group `use crate::{NOTE, grouped_table};` next to an ordinary constant, with no `#[macro_use]`; the middle row sits on the limit.

mutants.equivalence_review: not equivalent: 5 against a limit of 5 no longer fits
not equivalent: 6 against a limit of 5 now fits

reasoning: Rows group_under(3, 5, true), group_at(5, 5, true) and group_over(6, 5, false) sit under and on both sides of the limit, so `limit > width` fails group_at and `limit + 1 >= width` fails group_over. The generator `grouped_table!` is `#[macro_export]` in tests/export_support/mod.rs and the invoking module imports it in a group with a constant that is not a macro, so ripr has to hoist the one exported definition and leave `NOTE` imported. Spec cell: RIPR-SPEC-0117 example 12 (#10298).
